About Us

Trusted by Organizers Who Can't Afford a Bad Event

Lafayette Sound is a full-service live event production company based in Lafayette, Indiana. With over 12 years of experience and 500+ events delivered, we provide broadcast-quality audio, video, lighting, staging, and live streaming — for groups of 20 or 2,000.
